$comment: The product's name, in one place. Everything user-visible derives from this; the declaration sites that cannot import it are checked against it by src/lib/brandAssets.test.ts, which names every file it verifies. Renaming the product means editing this file and running that test until it stops complaining.
name: Outsie
$identifiers: NOT derived from `name`, and must not be. These appear on disk, on the air, and inside HMAC pre-images shared with the phone; a rename that swept them would silently orphan an installed plugin or make every beacon fail to verify, which looks exactly like a phone that is out of range. They are recorded here so the next person renaming the product can see what was deliberately left behind.
